# ResolvedBorder

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The canonical border pair. BonniePDF models widths and colours separately ([`Border`](border.md) + [`BorderColors`](border-colors.md)), so a single authoring value resolves to both; `colors` is `undefined` when the input carried no colour.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`border`](#border): The border widths.
- [`colors`](#colors): The border colours, or `undefined` when the input carried no colour.

### `border`

```typescript
border: Border
```

The border widths.

### `colors`

```typescript
colors?: BorderColors | undefined
```

*optional*

The border colours, or `undefined` when the input carried no colour.
